record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add a jointly trained residual feed-forward block to GRU outputs before the unchanged recency readout: h'=h+W2(GELU(W1(h))), with hidden width 128, biases zero and W2 initialized to zero. This preserves the initial mapping while allowing nonlinear refinement within each category's single recurrent model. Keep embeddings, readout settings, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer fixed; update the predictor writer for matching checkpoint parameters.

category_rationales.rationale: Add a jointly trained 128-unit residual GELU block before the existing recency readout across all four category models. Zero initialization of the output projection preserves the initial recurrent mapping. Keep embeddings, scoring, loss, optimizer and history handling fixed; record the block width for matching predictor construction.
